BBC News, 22 Jul 2026 03:05 GMT — US launches 11th consecutive night of strikes on Iran (late Tue). CENTCOM: strikes "designed to continue degrading Iran's ability to threaten commercial shipping" in Strait of Hormuz; targeted military operations centres, maritime capabilities, aircraft hangars, drone storage, logistics. Iranian air defences activated over Tehran; explosions in Tabriz, Chabahar, Konarak, Bushehr (nuclear power plant city). Trump threatens to hit "Pickaxe Mountain" underground nuclear site near Natanz "pretty soon, and very heavily." Iran's Khatam al-Anbiya command: would treat such an attack "as an expansion of war." Kuwait, Bahrain, Jordan intercepted Iranian drone/missile strikes. War cost US $37.5bn (Hegseth). Ceasefire agreed April, MoU signed June, Trump declared "over" last week.
